meta.parties: Indian Bank Ltd. v. Charted Bank Et Al

rules.statement: Section 18 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance does not require a 'bill of sale' to be in writing, and the term 'executed' should be given its ordinary meaning.
rules.supporting_quote: "Nor do I think that the word" executed" in section 18 of the present Ordinance conveys the idea that the" bill of sale" referred to is 'a written' bill of sale. I do not see any reason why the word" executed" should not be given its ordinary meaning" carried into complete effect"."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance
